newsitem.title: USA: Hormel see charge for catfish business sale.
newsitem.headline: Hormel see charge for catfish business sale.

text.p: Hormel Foods Corp said Friday it expects to take a charge of $5,400,000 against fiscal 1996 earnings for the proposed sale of its Farm Fresh Catfish Co subsidiary.
Hormel said it signed a letter of intent to sell Farm Fresh Catfish, based in Hollandale, Miss.
Hormel said the proposed buyer and terms of the sale were not disclosed. Farm Fresh is one of the largest growers and processors of farm-raised catfish in the United States, it added.

"The impending sale is in the best interests of Farm Fresh Catfish Co and Hormel Foods Corp," V. Allan Krejci, director of public relations, said in a statement. "The sale will allow the new owners of Farm Fresh to direct complete attention to building volumes and market distribution of this business."
